versions.note: Shipped rules. Alts tilt while bitcoin is above its 100-day average and return to the entered weights below it. The other three books tilt while bitcoin is above its 200-day average and otherwise leave the book alone. Leader weight 80%, 30-day momentum, 50-day trend, every 14 days.
